front: When and where was SADCC founded?
When and where was SADC created?
Name the nine founders of SADCC.
back: Angola, Botswana, Lesotho, Malawi, Mozambique, Swaziland (Eswatini), Tanzania, Zambia, Zimbabwe.
To reduce economic dependence, especially on apartheid South Africa, and co-ordinate regional development.

front: When did South Africa join SADC?

back: Summit of Heads of State and Government; Organ on Politics, Defence and Security; Council of Ministers; Secretariat (also the Tribunal and National Committees).

front: Give three successes and three weaknesses of SADC.
back: Successes: corridors, Power Pool, mediation (e.g. Zimbabwe 2008). Weaknesses: donor dependence, slow integration, South African dominance.
A group of countries that remove most tariffs on goods traded between them; SADC's was launched in 2008.
